chairmanReportRoute: Authenticated GET is no-store; requested/default year behavior is covered.
Malformed, repeated, unsupported-year, unknown-key, tenant-spoof, and role-spoof queries are rejected before principal or database access.
Only the session-derived principal is passed to report service; spoof headers do not override it.
Service denial returns safe 403; unauthenticated returns safe 401; internal invariant errors return generic 500; only GET is exposed.
chairmanReportService: Active Chairman can read their own RT report without changing dues, adjustments, requests, payments, allocations, reversals, waivers, or audit rows.
Disabled account, ended assignment, Treasurer, Resident, and System Admin are denied.
Forged other-RT principal is denied; available billing years from another RT are not disclosed.
reportPageBoundary: The page derives the principal from the authenticated session, redirects unauthenticated users to /login/pengurus, routes MFA enrollment to setup, and returns not-found for users without Chairman report permission or an RT assignment.

executionPolicy: Serial local authorization suite; no production or Neon access.
